problems: Repair run: 3 blocking findings applied by this run (Nafpaktos removed from the 1374-1376 Spata land in despotate-of-arta and despotate-of-angelokastron-and-lepanto, with new keyframe despotate-of-arta_1374; Glarentza 1408 gain and keyframe house-of-tocco_1408 in house-of-tocco); 5 earlier fixes were applied by the reviewer and were checked, not redone. All three dossiers validate with 0 errors; despotate-of-arta carries 2 expected warnings ('hospitaller-rhodes' has no dossier yet, requested above).

despotate-of-epirus (not mine): needs a July 1414 loss of Glarentza to principality-of-achaea (Glarentza page: 'a Venetian-mediated deal restored the city to Centurione in July 1414'; Centurione II Zaccaria page 'At 1414 ... expel the Toccos'); its ledger has the 1421 purchase and the 1428 handover but no 1414 loss. Its keyframes should include the Tocco islands and Glarentza from February 1411 (the 1395 shape lacks them; Cliopatria draws them from 1415) and Arta's land from 1416 (the 1415 shape lacks it); its 1359 loss to despotate-of-arta covers both Albanian halves and should also name despotate-of-angelokastron-and-lepanto.

principality-of-achaea (not mine): ledger 36, the 1414 gain of Glarentza, names house-of-tocco as counterpart; the Tocco county ended in February 1411, so the counterpart should be despotate-of-epirus. Ledger 35 (1408 loss to house-of-tocco) now has its matching gain in house-of-tocco. The Glarentza page says 'late 1407' for the seizure; the Achaea ledger and this dossier keep 1408.

catalan-company (not mine): has no 1361 gain of Nafpaktos and no 1376 loss of it to despotate-of-arta (Nafpaktos page: 'In 1361 the town was captured by the Catalans of the Duchy of Athens'; 'In 1376 or 1377 it fell to John Bua Spata'); despotate-of-arta ledger 2 now names catalan-company as counterpart.

Cliopatria's Despotate of Arta shape of 1375 contains Nafpaktos; the dossier applies it from 1376 and uses despotate-of-arta_1374 for 1374-1375. The Hospitaller interval 1378-1380 is still drawn as Spata land. The circle is 2 of the shape's 31 grid cells.

Epirus dossier keyframe 1415-1421 (14,440 km2, bbox 19.92-21.72 E, 37.64-40.36 N) does not obviously contain the Arta land; despotate-of-arta ends 4 October 1416 (Cliopatria draws the Arta shape to 1421), so 1417-1421 needs the 1416 handover to despotate-of-epirus (its ledger already has the matching gain) or an Epirus keyframe fix.

house-of-tocco ends February 1411 (merge into despotate-of-epirus) while Cliopatria ends the row in 1414 and the Epirus keyframes draw the islands only from 1415: 1411-1414 relies on the successor handover, which now includes Glarentza.

Cliopatria's Byzantine Empire shape of 1352-1362 overlaps 3 grid cells of the Tocco islands (Zakynthos and east Cephalonia); the pages put them under Angevin then Tocco rule, so the Byzantine dossier should drop them.
